major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown whenever the fight will last another 25 seconds, then chain Blackout Kick and Breath of Fire inside it and spend each Blackout Combo on Tiger Palm rather than Keg Smash.

major_cooldowns.name: Exploding Keg
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Throw it on cooldown with Rushing Jade Wind already rolling, then cash in the Keg Smash reset it gives you.

major_cooldowns.name: Touch of Death
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it the moment the target's health drops below your own maximum, or below 15% if you took Improved Touch of Death.

major_cooldowns.name: Chi Burst
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown, and open with it from maximum range while you close the gap to your target.

major_cooldowns.name: Black Ox Brew
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Chug it only when both Purifying Brew charges and Celestial Infusion are down and your Energy is low, then spend a Purifying Brew charge straight away.

defensives.name: Fortifying Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Press it ahead of a big damage window rather than at low health, since Keg Smash and Tiger Palm cut its cooldown roughly in half.
defensives.id_note: 115203 is the cast id; the self aura the logs carry is 120954.

defensives.name: Purifying Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Drink a charge right after a big hit lands, and never leave both charges sitting full.

defensives.name: Celestial Infusion
defensives.usage_rule: Spend a charge often to keep the absorb rolling, keeping one in reserve when a known spike is close.

defensives.name: Celestial Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Take it over Celestial Infusion against spiky damage and save it for the hits that need a full absorb.
defensives.id_note: Choice node against Celestial Infusion; no casts in the sampled parses, which all played Celestial Infusion (1241059).

defensives.name: Expel Harm
defensives.usage_rule: Press it to sweep up your Healing Spheres when your health dips.
defensives.id_note: Ability table gives a 15s base cooldown; the guide prose says 5s.

rules.description: Shuffle up for the whole fight
rules.action: Chain Blackout Kick and Keg Smash so Shuffle keeps refreshing.

rules.description: Breath of Fire kept up on the boss
rules.action: Recast Breath of Fire as soon as Keg Smash resets it.

rules.description: Keg Smash and Blackout Kick lead the opener
rules.action: Lead with Keg Smash into Blackout Kick, follow with Breath of Fire, and summon Niuzao once those are out.
